scope: Normalized Part 1 character fragment and relationship shard formal records now carry direct sourceType/credibility/canonStatus fields; this index remains only a coverage summary and fallback note, not the sole provenance carrier.
directMetadataPolicy: Each formal normalized character fragment and relationship shard should carry sourceType=user-file-worldbook-script, credibility=B, canonStatus=canon-like unless a more specific local value is present.
unsupportedAliasPolicy: Unsupported external English canonical labels retained for reviewer awareness are placed in aliasCandidates with unsupported-by-current-source status, not in source-backed names/descriptions.
notes: R2 added direct provenance/status fields to normalized formal character fragments and relationship shards rather than relying only on this index.
Canonical relationship edge wrappers already carry per-file provenance for each normalized relationship shard.
